capabilities: open a popup calendar from the ribbon
jump to a Daily Notes page for a chosen date
enter a natural language date expression to navigate
extras: Documentation is hosted elsewhere; the README only briefly describes the plugin and points to the author's site and Twitter.
problem: Jumping to a specific date's Daily Notes page requires manual navigation or searching; there is no quick date-based way to get there.
summary: Popup calendar plugin that navigates to Daily Notes pages, either picked from a calendar or entered as a natural language date expression.
